class.name: VCSVWriter
class.brief_description:
Serializes tables / rows / dictionaries back to CSV or a file.
把表 / 行 / 字典序列化回 CSV 或文件。
class.description:
Applies RFC 4180 quoting: fields containing the delimiter, a quote, or a line break are quoted and embedded quotes are doubled. Line ending, always-quote and formula-injection guard are configurable. [method quote_field] is the static one-field helper.
应用 RFC 4180 引号规则：含分隔符、引号或换行的字段加引号，内部引号双写。行尾、全引号、公式注入防护均可配置。[method quote_field] 是单字段的静态辅助。

method.name: write_table_to_string
method.description:
Serializes a table (headers + data rows) to a CSV string.
把表（表头 + 数据行）序列化为 CSV 字符串。

method.name: write_table
method.description:
Writes a table to [param path]. Returns an [Error].
把表写入 [param path]。返回 [Error]。

method.name: write_rows_to_string
method.description:
Serializes rows (Array of [PackedStringArray], or Arrays of strings) with an optional header row.
序列化行（[PackedStringArray] 的 [Array]，或字符串 [Array]），可选表头行。

method.name: write_rows
method.description:
Writes rows to [param path]. Returns an [Error].
把行写入 [param path]。返回 [Error]。

method.name: from_dicts_to_string
method.description:
Serializes an Array of [Dictionary] rows; column order comes from [param column_order], or the first dict when empty.
序列化 [Dictionary] 的 [Array]；列序来自 [param column_order]，为空时取首个字典。

method.name: quote_field
method.description:
Returns [param field] quoted per the default delimiter/quote rules.
按默认分隔符/引号规则返回加引号后的 [param field]。

members.member:
Output field separator.
输出字段分隔符。

Output quote character.
输出引号字符。

Line ending appended after every record (default CRLF per RFC 4180).
每条记录后追加的行尾（默认 CRLF，RFC 4180）。

Quote every field.
所有字段都加引号。

Prefix fields starting with [code]=[/code], [code]+[/code] or [code]@[/code] with a single quote to block spreadsheet formula injection. ([code]-[/code] is left alone so negative numbers stay numeric.)
给以 [code]=[/code]、[code]+[/code] 或 [code]@[/code] 开头的字段加单引号前缀，阻止电子表格公式注入。（[code]-[/code] 不加，保证负数仍为数值。）
